applicability: The canonical task-document enumeration (_iter_task_json) that the always-on summary, series and closeout-queue projections consume, and that bounds which paths the body read's named-path probe may return.
conditions: A task root is exactly tasks/<repository>/<task>/; only its direct entries named *.json are candidates, of any entry type, and the reader accepts or refuses each.
A folder that cannot be listed contributes nothing, as the recursive glob behaved.
exclusions: Historical copies under notes/, report and enclosure folders, 0_archive, top-level JSON in a repository folder, and anything reached only through a symlinked directory.
The unrelated TaskDocumentTopology master-ref walk in tasks/document_refs.py, which is a different code path.
statement: The task-document enumeration lists only tasks/<repository>/<task>/ entries named *.json, does not descend symlinked directories, excludes any path through 0_archive or enclosures, and sorts only those entries, yielding exactly the list the previous recursive glob produced.
